title: The Sound Cultivator's Second Course
summary: A second course that takes the struck tone of the first books and teaches the student to ring a guard and rebuke a blow with the same note.

title: Companion to the Humming Frame
summary: A companion to the bone-humming primers that sets the whole frame resonating to give heavy rattling blows and a wall of shaking air.

title: A Treatise on Shaking Stone and Glass
summary: A treatise on finding the note at which a hard brittle thing fails and on striking at exactly that note.

title: The Wave-Caller's Handbook
summary: A handbook on calling a swell of sound out of the body and rolling it forward as a wave that pushes and sweeps.

title: Canon of the Heard and Unheard
summary: A canon of sounds too low or too faint for the common ear that teaches the student to hear them and to loose them as hidden force.

title: The Mending Tone Companion
summary: A companion that turns vibration to mending and teaches a steady chord for knitting hurts and shaking out taint.

title: A Course in Breaking Pitch
summary: A course in the high thin note that bores through a guard and in the shrill screen that spoils a foe's footing in return.
